Same-run production universal leaf updates at 4,000 unrelated siblings versus none. The fixed scoped path measures near 1x; 8x leaves sub-millisecond timer/JIT headroom while rejecting both the former whole-root replay (hundreds of times slower) and the object-driver full-map clone (tens of times slower).

State in the root component replays from the root range, and every clean leaf subtree is adopted without re-rendering (issue #574 follow-up). The dirty twin rewrites all 4,000 leaf props per press, so it must re-render each leaf; the clean run measures well under half of that (~0.25x observed). A ratio near 1x means retained-subtree adoption stopped engaging and clean leaves are re-rendering again.

One keyed @for item's setState hoists to its 20-item list component instead of replaying the root, so 4,000 out-of-scope siblings must not change its cost. Rejects the anonymous-owner bail that sent list-item state through a whole-root replay.

A leaf setState under an idle @try boundary stays scoped; only an active suspense or error episode may fall back to the root. Rejects the blanket ancestor-boundary bail that disabled scoped updates for any app with an error boundary near the root.

A leaf update that inserts or removes one host commits through the scope's physical frame (nearest host parent plus end anchor) instead of replaying the root. Rejects the shape-stability bail that sent every structural update through a whole-root replay.

Compact leaf rows driven by their list component's selection state replay only that component (its 100 rows), so unrelated siblings must not change the cost. Rejects the compact-range bail that forced list selection through a whole-root replay.

Same-run production Chromium effectful mount/update/unmount cycles with exact listener, subscription, interval, effect-cleanup, and post-teardown correctness gates. A verified quick run measured below 2x; 3x leaves real-browser noise headroom.

Same-run Playwright typing into 512 controlled fields while preserving the input, focus, insertion caret, and latest validation. A verified quick run measured about 1.01x; 2x leaves browser and keyboard-event noise headroom.

Same-run 512-subscriber useSyncExternalStore fan-out, gated on complete visible updates, rapid-write consistency, and exact listener teardown. A verified quick run measured about 1.01x; 2x leaves real-browser scheduling headroom.

Twenty unrelated parent re-renders across 512 selector-based subscribers with the store untouched, gated on every subscriber still showing the correct total and the new generation. Octane and React Compiler both stabilize the capture-free selector, avoiding selector recomputation across 10,240 subscriber renders and snapshot reads. A verified normal eight-iteration run measured 0.98345x with zero selector calls for both frameworks; 1.5x retains scheduling-noise headroom while guarding against renewed selector recomputation or an Octane render-pass regression.
Same-run production Chromium hydration under real 6x CPU throttling: Octane measured about 0.4x React while preserving pre-hydration input. The 1.5x ceiling leaves browser and machine-noise headroom.
Same-run production Chromium controlled-input hydration under real 6x CPU throttling: Octane measured about 0.4x React and must preserve the complete pre-hydration draft, focus, and caret.
create-1k: octane must not fall to >2x React's create time (known ~0.8-1.0x; generous headroom).
partial update: octane vs React (known ~1x).
